key_insights: Bitcoin's reclaim of 20K is a major technical and narrative breakthrough
Double failed breaks pattern identified at 17.6K level led to acceleration
Bitcoin in consolidation phase targeting range high of 22.6K from midpoint 20.7K
Ethereum showing strength with 1400 reclaim, but structure less clear than Bitcoin

summary: Bitcoin has reclaimed the critical 20K level, marking a significant technical and psychological breakthrough. The market is now in a consolidation phase with targets at the range high of 22.6K, presenting long opportunities at the 20.3-20.7K midpoint or on pullbacks to 19K. Ethereum has shown strength with its 1400 reclaim but has less clear structure, while Solana faces weekly resistance making it a weaker bullish candidate.
